title: Mine 9yr Old Goes To Mallworld
content: I don’t talk about mallworld with anyone because well… idk I don’t wanna sounds nuts. My daughter a couple days go said that she had a really cool dream. Im like yo let me hear it. She said she was at an apartment building and our whole family was there. She said not only was it our immediate family but even people that had passed away. Our WHOLE family. She said everyone was talking and laughing. Immediate family members had their own room. With a bed and all the rooms were connected. Then when they left the rooms they took a train that was connected to the apartments to somewhere to have fun. She told me some more about her destination but I can’t remember it exactly. But the whole time she is telling me this I’m like… that’s fuckin mallworld.
